name: banza-l2-readiness
description: banza-l2-readiness (BX1.8): local, no-network preparation of the L2 payment-flow surface. It reads the Operator Manifest, SimB pre-review, Conformidade L0 and L1 readiness reports, and validates the minimum BANZA payment-flow artifacts — payment intent, idempotency handling, double-entry ledger postings, trace linkage, settlement obligation and an evidence reference — computing the L2 readiness status IN RUST. L2 readiness is technical preparation of a payment flow — NOT a real payment, NOT certification, NOT approval; it does not create an operator and does not move funds.
